## Summary
Scoped follow-up of #44398: validate the AISBench perf path of the NPU nightly multi-node pipeline with the shortest acceptance scenario — cold prefill 16k in / 1 out, C1/N1, GSM8K exact-length dataset, 4-node mix 32P (server launch identical to the scoped accuracy case).

- Add `python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/run_aisbench.sh`: `run_aisbench()` in `test_npu_performance_utils.py` references this script, but it was never checked in, so the `AISBENCHMARK` branch of the perf framework could not run. The script installs `ais-bench-benchmark` from the Tsinghua mirror into a local venv (reusing a system-wide install when present), renders a single-file task config (SGLang streaming API + custom jsonl + `default_perf`) and streams the result tables consumed by the metric parser.
- Add `test/registered/npu/performance/kimi_k3/test_npu_kimi_k3_w4a8_32p_mix_in16k_out1_prefill.py`: 16k in / 1 out, TTFT gate 6000 ms is a pipeline-validation threshold (historical ~5 s at C1); the 4.0 s acceptance SLO is tracked separately.
- Scope `nightly-test-npu.yml` to this perf trial only (B103 image kept); the L2 HiCache accuracy case stays with #44398 to keep 4-node pool load minimal.

## Test plan
- [ ] CI run of `nightly-test-npu.yml` triggered by this PR
- [ ] `multi-node-mix-poc (kimi_k3_w4a8_32p_mix_in16k_out1_prefill_aisbench)` job starts 4-node B103 pods
- [ ] aisbench venv install + task config render in-pod
- [ ] Common Metric table parsed (mean_ttft dumped to metrics file)

+#!/bin/bash
+# AISBench runner for the NPU E2E perf tests.
+#
+# Invoked by run_aisbench() in test_npu_performance_utils.py with:
+#   run_aisbench.sh --mode perf --ip <ip> --port <port> --model <basename> \
+#     --model-path <path> --dataset-type <gsm8k|sharegpt|...> \
+#     --dataset-path <jsonl already generated by the caller> \
+#     --input-len <n> --output-len <n> --batch-size <n> --num-prompts <n> \
+#     --output-path <metrics file> \
+#     [--request_rate <r>] [--repeat_rate <r>] [--dp <n>] [--generation-kwargs '<dict>']
+#
+# Installs ais-bench-benchmark into a local venv when the ambient python does
+# not provide it, renders a single-file task config (SGLang OpenAI-compatible
+# streaming backend + custom jsonl dataset + default_perf summarizer), runs
+# `ais_bench` and streams its result tables to stdout. The caller parses the
+# "Common Metric ... total" rows, so nothing here may swallow that output.
+#
+# Prefix mode: when --repeat_rate is set (e.g. "100"), the dataset is
+# regenerated in-place as N *identical* prompts of --input-len tokens
+# (radix-cache friendly), a warm pass with output-len=1 primes the KV cache
+# of every DP rank, and only the measured pass is streamed to stdout.
+
+set -o pipefail
+
+pip_mirror_source="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/pypi/web/simple"
+AISBENCH_VENV="test_env_aisbench"
+AISBENCH_INSTALL_TIMEOUT=1800
+
+MODE="perf"
+IP=""
+PORT=""
+MODEL_NAME=""
+MODEL_PATH=""
+DATASET_TYPE=""
+DATASET_PATH=""
+INPUT_LEN=""
+OUTPUT_LEN=""
+BATCH_SIZE=""
+NUM_PROMPTS=""
+OUTPUT_PATH=""
+REQUEST_RATE="0"
+REPEAT_RATE=""
+DP=""
+GEN_KWARGS=""
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+    case "$1" in
+        --mode) MODE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --ip) IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --port) PORT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --model) MODEL_NAME="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --model-path) MODEL_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --dataset-type) DATASET_TYPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --dataset-path) DATASET_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --input-len) INPUT_LEN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --output-len) OUTPUT_LEN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --batch-size) BATCH_SIZE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --num-prompts) NUM_PROMPTS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --output-path) OUTPUT_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --request_rate) REQUEST_RATE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --repeat_rate) REPEAT_RATE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --dp) DP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        --generation-kwargs) GEN_KWARGS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
+        *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+    esac
+done
+
+[[ -n "${IP}" && -n "${PORT}" && -n "${MODEL_PATH}" && -n "${DATASET_PATH}" ]] || {
+    echo "ip/port/model-path/dataset-path are required" >&2
+    exit 2
+}
+
+# render_config <config_path> <max_out_len>
+# Optional extra generation kwargs, passed through as a python dict literal.
+if [ -n "${GEN_KWARGS}" ]; then
+    GEN_KWARGS_LINE="generation_kwargs=dict(${GEN_KWARGS}),"
+else
+    GEN_KWARGS_LINE="generation_kwargs=dict(temperature=0.0, ignore_eos=True),"
+fi
+
+render_config() {
+    cat > "$1" <<EOF
+from mmengine.config import read_base
+from ais_bench.benchmark.partitioners import NaivePartitioner
+from ais_bench.benchmark.runners.local import LocalRunner
+from ais_bench.benchmark.tasks import OpenICLApiInferTask
+
+with read_base():
+    from ais_bench.benchmark.configs.models.vllm_api.vllm_api_general_stream import models
+    from ais_bench.benchmark.configs.datasets.custom.custom_qa_gen import custom_datasets
+    from ais_bench.benchmark.configs.summarizers.perf.default_perf import summarizer
+
+models[0].update(
+    abbr='sglang-perf',
+    model='${MODEL_PATH}',
+    path='${MODEL_PATH}',
+    host_ip='${IP}',
+    host_port=${PORT},
+    stream=True,
+    retry=1,
+    request_rate=${REQUEST_RATE},
+    max_out_len=$2,
+    batch_size=${BATCH_SIZE},
+    ${GEN_KWARGS_LINE}
+)
+
+datasets = custom_datasets
+datasets[0]['abbr'] = 'ais-perf-${DATASET_TYPE}'
+datasets[0]['path'] = '${DATASET_PATH}'
+datasets[0]['reader_cfg']['input_columns'] = ['question']
+datasets[0]['infer_cfg']['prompt_template']['template'] = '{question}'
+
+infer = dict(
+    partitioner=dict(type=NaivePartitioner),
+    runner=dict(type=LocalRunner, task=dict(type=OpenICLApiInferTask)),
+)
+EOF
+}
+
+echo "===== Install aisbench - Begin ====="
+if command -v ais_bench >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "import ais_bench" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "aisbench found in the system python, reuse it."
+    AIS_BENCH_BIN="$(command -v ais_bench)"
+else
+    if [ ! -x "${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/ais_bench" ]; then
+        python3 -m venv "${AISBENCH_VENV}"
+        "${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/pip" install -U pip -i "${pip_mirror_source}"
+        # pyarrow is capped below 16: ais-bench pulls a numpy<2 tree (common on
+        # torch-npu environments), and pyarrow>=16 requires numpy>=2, which
+        # crashes "import ais_bench" with "pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer".
+        timeout "${AISBENCH_INSTALL_TIMEOUT}" \
+            "${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/pip" install ais-bench-benchmark "pyarrow<16" \
+            -i "${pip_mirror_source}" || {
+            echo "ERROR: aisbench install timed out or failed after ${AISBENCH_INSTALL_TIMEOUT}s." >&2
+            exit 1
+        }
+    fi
+    # Fail fast with an explicit message when the venv is still broken.
+    SMOKE_OK=1
+    "${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/python" - <<'PYEOF' || SMOKE_OK=0
+import ais_bench  # noqa: F401
+from ais_bench.benchmark.cli.config_manager import ConfigManager  # noqa: F401
+print("aisbench import smoke test OK")
+PYEOF
+    if [ "${SMOKE_OK}" -ne 1 ]; then
+        echo "ERROR: aisbench import smoke test failed, see the traceback above." >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    echo "aisbench installed in ${AISBENCH_VENV}."
+    AIS_BENCH_BIN="${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/ais_bench"
+fi
+echo "===== Install aisbench - End ====="
+
+if [[ -n "${REPEAT_RATE}" ]]; then
+    echo "===== Prefix mode (repeat_rate=${REPEAT_RATE}): regenerate identical-prompt dataset ====="
+    "${AISBENCH_VENV}/bin/python" - "${MODEL_PATH}" "${DATASET_PATH}" "${INPUT_LEN}" "${NUM_PROMPTS}" <<'PYEOF'
+import json
+import sys
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+model_path, out_path, input_len, num_prompts = (
+    sys.argv[1],
+    sys.argv[2],
+    int(sys.argv[3]),
+    int(sys.argv[4]),
+)
+tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
+seed = "Explain the theory of relativity in detail."
+ids = tok.encode(seed, add_special_tokens=False)
+full = (ids * (input_len // len(ids) + 1))[:input_len]
+text = tok.decode(full)
+row = {"question": text, "answer": "none"}
+with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+    for _ in range(num_prompts):
+        f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
+print(f"prefix dataset: {num_prompts} identical rows of {input_len} tokens -> {out_path}")
+PYEOF
+    [[ $? -eq 0 ]] || { echo "ERROR: prefix dataset generation failed" >&2; exit 1; }
+
+    echo "===== Warm pass (output-len=1, primes KV cache on every DP rank) - Begin ====="
+    WARM_CFG="$(mktemp /tmp/aisbench_warm_XXXXXX.py)"
+    render_config "${WARM_CFG}" 1 || exit 1
+    WARM_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aisbench_warm_out_XXXXXX)"
+    "${AIS_BENCH_BIN}" "${WARM_CFG}" --mode "${MODE}" --work-dir "${WARM_DIR}" \
+        > "${WARM_DIR}/warm.log" 2>&1 \
+        || echo "WARN: warm pass failed (continuing to the measured pass), see ${WARM_DIR}/warm.log"
+    echo "===== Warm pass - End ====="
+fi
+
+CFG_FILE="$(mktemp /tmp/aisbench_task_XXXXXX.py)"
+render_config "${CFG_FILE}" "${OUTPUT_LEN}"
+
+echo "===== aisbench task config ====="
+cat "${CFG_FILE}"
+echo "================================="
+
+OUTPUT_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aisbench_outputs_XXXXXX)"
+LOG_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/aisbench.log"
+if [ -n "${OUTPUT_PATH}" ]; then
+    mkdir -p "$(dirname "${OUTPUT_PATH}")" 2>/dev/null || true
+fi
+
+"${AIS_BENCH_BIN}" "${CFG_FILE}" \
+    --mode "${MODE}" \
+    --work-dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
+    2>&1 | tee "${LOG_FILE}"
+RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+
+if [ -n "${OUTPUT_PATH}" ] && [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]; then
+    cp -r "${OUTPUT_DIR}"/* "$(dirname "${OUTPUT_PATH}")"/ 2>/dev/null || true
+fi
+echo "aisbench outputs saved under ${OUTPUT_DIR} (rc=${RC})"
+exit "${RC}"
